columns.name: Key
columns.description: A unique ID for each site.

columns.name: Site Name
columns.description: Name of location

columns.name: Address
columns.description: Street Address of location. Please note: this address has not been normalized.

columns.name: City
columns.description: City of program, will always be located in Chicago.

columns.name: State
columns.description: State, will also be listed as IL

columns.name: ZIP
columns.description: Zip code

columns.name: Phone Number
columns.description: Phone number for program.

columns.name: URL
columns.description: Website address of program

columns.name: Ages Served
columns.description: Ages of children served.

columns.name: Ages 0-3
columns.description: Ages 0-3 served.

columns.name: Ages 3-5
columns.description: Ages 3-5 served.

columns.name: Weekday Availability
columns.description: Availability of program: including full week, full day, or part day programs.

columns.name: Duration/Hours
columns.description: The availability of the program throughout the year and hours of operation. The hours of operation will correspond to the WEEKDAY AVAILABILITY column.

columns.name: Program Information
columns.description: Indicates whether the program is administered by community-based organizations (e.g., YMCA), Chicago Public Schools (CPS), or other organizations.

columns.name: Languages other than English
columns.description: Languages spoken other than English, comma separated.

columns.name: Other Features
columns.description:
Other features of the program.

CCAP indicates the Child Care Assistance Program. The program is administered by DHS and helps qualifying families help for childcare. See more at http://www.dhs.state.il.us/page.aspx?item=30355

columns.name: Accreditation
columns.description: Indicates if the program is accredited by  the National Association for the Education of Young Children (NAEYC), National Early Childhood Program Accreditation (NEPCA), or the Council on Accreditation (COA).

columns.name: Quality
columns.description: Will be available in January 2014.

columns.name: Quality Rating
columns.description: Will be available in 2014.

columns.name: Latitude
columns.description: Latitude coordinates based on WGS84.

columns.name: Longitude
columns.description: Longitude coordinates based on WGS84.

columns.name: Location
columns.description: The latitude and longitude coordinates based on the LATITUDE and LONGITUDE fields in this dataset.
